machine.note: EVERY number below is one real run on THIS machine (the committed receipts are the record); budgets = baseline + a deliberately padded margin, warn-tier until a few machines confirm them. Wall-clock metrics are noisy on this shared box (coldBoot measured 28/190/99ms across three runs under fleet load) — margins are sized to catch ORDER-OF-MAGNITUDE regressions, not jitter. leak.growthBytes was byte-identical across all three runs (8,347,650). Re-record by re-running the legs and updating both sides together.

boot.coldBootMs.what: eval start → bootUpstream's agent registered (in-runtime cold boot, mobile profile, mock route)

boot.processColdStartMs.what: process spawn → PASS (shell-side wall clock; includes runtime init + eval + pump loop)

market.catalogRefreshMs.what: catalog fetch + PURE-JS ed25519 verify over 9 entries (BigInt verify dominates; the known cost)

market.installCommitMs.what: installFromFetch over the signed entry: tgz fetch → extract → trust-record verify → commit

bytes.spikeBundleC.what: the generated iOS embed (hosts/ios/App/Generated/SpikeBundle.c, gitignored build output since D9) — closure-growth tripwire

bytes.marketTgz.what: dsh-fs@0.1.0.tgz as authored from system-plugins/ with fixed TEST seeds (deterministic bytes)

leak.growthBytes.what: leak.canary: post-GC minus pre-GC heap over 100 mock session rounds (the canary leg itself fails its scenario past this tolerance; this row is the trend audit of the same number).
